Commentary.Commentary: UPDATE 1716 LOCAL TIME - Good news, folks! It has gone bright out at The Oval and we won't have a delayed start. So the match will restart at 1730 local time.

UPDATE 1706 LOCAL TIME - We have not yet arrived at the restart time but the rain has got heavier and the covers have been brought on. Let's hope that it's a passing shower and we are not in for a big delay. Stay tuned for further updates.

Tamim Iqbal once again was the standout batsman for the Tigers. Shakib Al Hasan provided him some support in the middle as the duo put up a 69-run stand, but he departed against the run of play. Tamim carried on and in the quest to up the ante, fell short of what would have been a deserving century. The target is an easy one for Australia to chase and if the rain doesn't interrupt, they'll back themselves to gun it down. Join us in a while for the second half of the match.

An excellent bowling performance from Australia. They started off well, cramped the Bangladeshi batsmen for runs, gave away some runs in the middle and finished off well in the death. Barring Glenn Maxwell, everybody chipped in with the wickets with Mitchell Starc scalping all 4 of his right towards the end, with 3 of them coming in a single over. Adam Zampa was brought in after the 34th over strangely and despite that, he picked up 2 wickets. Says it all about the Aussies in the field today.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Starc has his 4th of the match. He's come back well in these death overs and ran right through the Bangladesh lower order batsmen. He comes steaming in from around the wicket and bowls it full on middle, Mehedi Hasan misses and the furniture is disturbed. BANGLADESH ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 182!
Lands it on a fuller length on off, Mustafizur chips it towards point. It falls wide of the fielder there as the batsmen take a single.
Good length delivery just outside off, Mustafizur makes room to hit it over the off side but doesn't end up playing a shot in the end.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails. Back-to-back maidens for Australia.
Short of a good length, around off, Hasan looks to pull but misses.
This is what he should be bowling at this stage, full on middle and off, drilled to covers. Dot ball.
Mehedi makes room and Pat follows him. It's short and angling in, the batsman looks to pull but gets an inside edge back to the keeper on the bounce.
Angling back in on middle and off, Mehedi Hasan stands his ground and defends it off the inner half down on the track.
As expected, Pat Cummins with a back of a length ball on off, jammed out to the covers for nothing.
Pat Cummins is back on!

Full and tailing back in, flicked straight to the square leg fielder. You don't say this often in cricket, but that's a triple-wicket maiden from Mitchell Starc. Brilliant, brilliant over comes to an end.

Almost... Almost! Wow. That's a very good ball. From over the wicket, Mitchell Starc arrows in a yorker and it just about takes the off stump. Mustafizur tried getting his bat down to it but missed it completely.
Mustafizur Rehman is the last man in. Starc on hat-trick. Can he get it?

OUT! Starc has his 3rd and he's on a hat-trick now. This is excellent bowling from the pacer. Spears in a full delivery on the stumps, Rubel Hossain makes a lot of room to squeeze it out on the off side but gets no wood on the ball. The stumps are disturbed and that's another one sent back to the pavilion.
Rubel Hossain walks out to bat.

OUT! BAM! He's bowled 'em. Starc goes straight, attacks the stumps at 142 kph and gets the desired result. Goes full and angles it in on middle and leg, Mashrafe Mortaza with no foot movement looks to bring his bat down but misses the ball completely. It straightened up just a touch after pitching which did Mortaza in.
Switches the angle to around the wicket and fires in a full delivery just outside off, it whiskers past the off pole as the batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Mashrafe Mortaza is the new man in.

OUT! How unfortunate, Tamim Iqbal has missed out on his ton by 5 runs. Poor guy, you've got to feel for him. Starc gets his first of the match as well. It's banged short on middle and off, Iqbal looks to half-pull but gets a big top edge which skies towards fine leg. Hazlewood comes running in and dives forward to take a good catch. Bangladesh needed him to stick around in these death overs, this isn't good for them.
Darted around off, looks to sweep but misses.
Kneels down to this full ball and paddles it fine down the leg side for a brace.
Flatter and straighter around off, Tamim dabs it just wide of the short third man fielder and takes one.
Give this some decent flight and floats it up on a driving length around off, Mehedi plays with the turn and drives it through towards sweeper cover for one.
Flat, short and around off, rocks back and cuts it to short third man. He hurries to the ball and throws it back tumbling in, even though the batsmen weren't really taking the run.
Tossed up outside off, Mehedi Hasan prods forward and defends it in front of covers.
Change of ends for Adam Zampa.
The intensity of rain has increased. Let's see when the umpires take the call of going off the field.
From around the wicket for the last ball of the over, full toss outside off, run down to third man off the outer half for a single.
Tailing back in on middle and leg, Tamim picks it off his pads and flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, the southpaw looks to flick but misses.
Good length delivery outside off, it's run past the keeper with a deft touch. The third man fielder covers a lot of ground to his right and cuts it off. The batsmen take two runs.
Over the wicket now, it's on the shorter side once more, Tamim rises and taps it down on the off side.
Angling in from around off, on a back of a length, tapped away on the off side for a single.
Starc from around the wicket angles in a length delivery on off, Mehedi Hasan opens the bat face and taps it to point.
Mitchell Starc returns to the attack.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring now.
Length delivery, angling in, Mehedi gets across and tucks it to fine leg for a single.
Short again, angling across, Tamim shimmies and pulls it in the square leg region for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, glided to third man for a single.
Slightly ahead of length outside off, Hasan defends it neatly from within the crease.
Once again a touch behind length, Iqbal gently taps it on the leg side and takes a quick single. Moves to 90!
Back of a length delivery around leg, Iqbal pulls it through backward square leg for a couple.
Fires it on middle and leg, Mehedi makes room and flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Poor delivery, punished! Long hop from Zampa, Hasan goes back and hits it past Hazlewood at short fine leg for a boundary.
Leg break around leg, Iqbal prods forward and with soft hands clips it in the backward square leg region for a single.
Mehedi goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Full in the line of the stumps, Hasan flicks it off the front foot to mid-wicket.
Hasan plays it towards short third man.
It has started to come down harder now. The umpires are waiting to see if this is just a passing shower.
Angling down leg, tucked to fine leg for a single.
Length delivery in the line of the stumps, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery on the shorter side, Iqbal pulls it over backward square leg for a brace.
Short and angling in, pulled to fine leg for a single. That almost carried to the fine leg fielder.
It has started drizzling at The Oval.
On a length outside off, Mehedi defends it back to the bowler.
Length delivery outside off, angling away, Iqbal dabs it to third man for a single.
Josh Hazlewood comes back into the attack.
Mehedi Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! Another one for Zampa! Where was he all this time? Flatter delivery around off, Mahmudullah camps back and looks to cut but ends up getting an inside edge onto the stumps. Bangladesh are suffering a collapse once again. They are in huge trouble now.

Shout for lbw! Slider, Mahmudullah kneels down and looks to sweep but misses and gets rapped on the pads. There's a huge appeal for lbw but it's turned down. Smith asks his keeper if the review should be taken but he suggests the ball might be sliding down leg.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single.
Leg spinner in the line of the stumps, Iqbal flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Full on middle, Iqbal prods forward and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Mahmudullah goes back, makes room and places it to backward point.
Another arm ball from Maxi, Mahmudullah prods forward to defend but gets beaten past his outside edge.
SIX! What a shot! Maxwell slides it across the batsman, who dances down and clobbers it with the bounce over long on for a maximum. That's a huge maximum!
Full outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Mahmudullah kneels down and paddle scoops it on the full in the fine leg region for a single.
Dabbed to short third man for a single.
Glenn Maxwell comes into the attack now.
Full in the line of the stumps, pushed back to the bowler. Wicket-maiden from Zampa! Absolutely superb stuff this!
Tossed up around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Googly around off, spins sharply, Mahmudullah goes back and punches it in covers. He didn't pick that out of his hand.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Mahmudullah to bat next for Bangladesh.

OUT! Zampa strikes straightaway! What a start by the leggie. Gives it a nice loop outside off, spinning away, Rahman gets lured in an expansive drive but doesn't keep it along the ground. Hits it straight to Smith at short extra cover, who takes a sharp catch. Bangladesh have lost half their side now. Now the question arises that why was Zampa brought in so late?
Tosses it up nicely, Sabbir dances down and drives it on the full back to the bowler.
Finally, Adam Zampa is brought into the attack. After 34 overs have been completed.
Drinks are on the field!
Short delivery, angling in, pulled behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length, angling in, tucked to fine leg for a single.
Pitched outside off, glided to third man for a single.

In the air... but safe! Short and angling in, Iqbal looks to pull but gets a top edge and the ball falls between the mid on and the mid-wicket fielder for a single. Tamim is struggling a touch and looking desperate to up the ante. Just like he started doing it in the England match.
Iqbal dances down the track and pulls the shortish delivery down the track. Zampa at mid on, hares across and makes a good stop.
On a length outside off, dabbed square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Wide outside off, Iqbal flashes his bat at it but misses.
Again it's back of a length outside off, Sabbir punches it through cover-point for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Tamim nudges it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, angling in, Iqbal dances down, makes room and slaps it to mid off.
FOUR! Well-placed! Short delivery, angling in. Iqbal gets across and pulls it over short backward square leg. Beats the fine leg fielder also and the ball reaches the fence.
Back of a length outside off, Iqbal gets across to play across the line but gets an inside edge onto the body.
Leg bye! Iqbal gets a long way across, looks to pull it across the line but gets beaten and is rapped on the thigh pad.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and angling in, Rahman gets on his toes and places it on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, punched on the off side.
On a length outside off, Rahman looks to punch it but the ball nips in and whizzes past the inside edge of Sabbir's bat.

Length delivery around leg, angling across, Iqbal dances down and looks to pull but gets an inside edge past the leg pole. Wade behind the stumps, dives to his right but manages to half-stop it. A single is taken.
Josh Hazlewood is back into the attack.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Sabbir gets on his toes and blocks it on the off side.

Strong appeal for lbw! Cross-seam delivery, angling in, keeps a touch low. Rahman is surprised by the ball keeping low and is late to put his bat to ball. Gets rapped on the thigh pad and there's a huge appeal for lbw. However, it's turned down and Cummins wants a review to be taken. Wade and the mid off fielder suggest against it to Smith and so he opts against it. The replays show that it was high.
Shortish delivery around leg, Iqbal stays tall and tucks it on the leg side for a single.
Pitched outside off, Rahman glided it past backward point for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Darted on the leg stump line, Sabbir paddles it fine down the leg side and takes two to get off the mark.
Sabbir Rahman is the next man in.

OUT! HE'S GONE! But that decision is a bit harsh really. Seems a little unfair on the batsman. Head from around the wicket bowls a slider around off, it's coming in with the angle as Shakib Al Hasan walks down the track to defend. Is rapped on the pads and there's a huge appeal for a leg before. The umpire raises his finger and Shakib immediately takes the review. Replays show that the impact is the umpire's call and the ball was going on to hit the stumps. Al Hasan was well down the track, he maybe could have gotten the benefit of the doubt on the on-field call.
Shakib has been adjudged lbw but he has opted for the review. He was way down the track but still was given out!
Darted wide outside off, Tamim steps out once more and lofts it over covers. It falls well short of the man in the deep and so, the batsmen take a single.
Tamim Iqbal plays it with an angled bat and guides it to short third man.
SIX! Two in two now. Seems he's decided he's going after Head. Skids down once more and clears the long off boundary for a maximum. That was a clean hit, made excellent connection on that occasion.
SIX! Oh, what a shot! That's a magnificent hit. Iqbal dances down the track, makes a little room for himself too and smokes it over extra cover for a biggie.
Back of a length well outside off, steered to point to end the over.
Length ball just outside off, dabbed in front of covers. No run taken.

From around the wicket again, coming in on a back of a length, Iqbal looks to work it on the leg side but it brushes his gloves and strikes his on the rib cage. He completes the single but seems to be in some pain. Must have stung, that.
Over the wicket now, it's outside off with some width to work with. Shakib runs it down to third man and crosses over.
Angling back into the batsman, tucked away to the mid-wicket area for a run.
Pat Cummins from around the wicket pounds in a ferocious bumper. Angles it in on middle and leg as Iqbal steps out to play. Is completely taken by surprise and just about manages to evade it.
Pat Cummins is back on!
Back of a length around off, kept out with a straight bat.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects to place it through the covers. They pick up a single.
Brings the wrists into play and works it away through mid-wicket for one more.
Tamim skips down the track, gets close to the pitch of the ball and drills it through the covers for a single.
50-run stand between Iqbal and Shakib!
Good drift for Head as it tosses it up there, Shakib works it away on the leg side for one.
Sliding in on off on a bit of a shorter length, Al Hasan rocks back and punches it a bit square on the off side.
Tamim keeps this out off the back foot and ends the over solidly.
Short of a good length outside off, it's punched behind point rather easily. Single taken to get off strike.
A low, dipping full toss from Mitchell Starc, the batsman can only mistime the drive back down towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, some room to work with as Shakib Al Hasan slashes it through point for a couple of good runs.
Full delivery outside off, driven towards deep mid off.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Low full toss wide outside off, Shakib reaches out to it and drives it square through backward point for a boundary.
Sliding in on the pads, Tamim works it on the leg side. Wade comes running to the ball and without looking at the stumps, hits the stumps at the striker's end. The batsman is well in by that time.
Darted full outside off, Iqbal drives it hard straight to Smith at short cover who collects the ball with his lightning hands.
Another punch, this time it's in the gap. Placed square of the wicket on the off side for one run.
Short and flat, sliding in on off, backs away a touch and punches it square to point.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Flat, short and wide outside off, cut away hard straight to point.
Just back of a length, angling down the leg side, Shakib looks to work it away to square leg but it bobbles off his gloves behind. A quick single is taken as the keeper runs in to collect the ball.
Connects well this time. Drives it sweetly along the ground to deep cover and takes one.
Full delivery well outside off, Tamim looks to cream it through the covers but scuffs it off the bottom edge in the same area.
Back of a length delivery jagging back in, Al Hasan rises and works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Angling back in on a length, Shakib stays put and plays it to covers.
Starts the over off with a full delivery, on off, blocked out from within the crease.
Mitchell Starc to have a change of ends.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
On the fuller side of things, driven back down the ground towards mid off for a single.
On a flatter trajectory, pushed again to the covers for no run.
37th ODI fifty for Tamim Iqbal!
Fifty for Tamim Iqbal! Played a good knock here, but he needs to carry on for his side. Just knocks this to long on and takes a single.
Flatter and full outside off, driven through to sweeper cover for a run.
Floats it up around off, pushed to the covers for nothing.
Travis Head is back on.
FOUR! 16 runs off the over, this is a big one for the Tigers. Henriques with a short ball down the leg side, easy pulled down fine for a boundary.
Fullish in length and fired across, driven through the covers for a single.
Iqbal works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! He's cutting loose here! he probably thinks it's time to shift gears. Isn't letting Henriques settle, dances down and pulls this short ball across the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
SIX! That's the way to play! Tamim Iqbal showing some aggressive intent here. He gives the charge to this length delivery and launches it over wide long off for the first biggie of the match.
Fuller around off, blocked.

DROPPED! That was hit really hard, though Maxwell should have taken that in all honesty. Short and wide, Shakib slashes it straight to point where Maxwell drops it. Seems to have hurt his left hand in the process. The batsmen come back for the second as there is a wayward throw at the striker's end.
Full and swinging away from around off, the strong wind helping with that. Driven straight back.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fired full again, well outside off. There's room on offer and Tamim Iqbal crashes this hard. It's straight to Steven Smith at short cover who collects the ball in a flash.
Bit fuller in length again, close to the off pole, Iqbal gets a big inside edge onto his pads as he plays at it.
Full outside the off stump, quite wide as Iqbal reaches out to it. Looks to push it to the off side but misses.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack.
Short again, it's pulled away once more for a single.
Shortish delivery around off, Tamim aerially pulls it past the short mid-wicket fielder. Takes two runs as the fielder out in the deep mops it up.
Full this time, driven to mid off for a quick single.
Outside off and it's slanting away, pushed to the covers for nothing.
Full and on the stumps, Shakib wants to drill this back down the ground. Ends up getting an inside edge onto his boot.
Good length delivery outside off, Shakib leans ahead a touch and drives it to mid off.
Full outside off, Shakib drives it through covers. Smith at extra cover, dives but half-stops it. A single is taken.
Served fuller around off, milked down to long on for a single.
Slides it into Tamim, who stays back and blocks.
Full outside off, Tamim drives it crisply but finds Smith at extra cover.
Full on middle and off, Al Hasan drives it through extra cover for a single.
Sliding in from around off, pushed to covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length, angling away, Shakib looks to slap it but is slightly cramped for room. Gets it off the outer half to third man for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Shakib latches onto this width in a flash and slashes it through covers. Finch in the deep, covers good ground to his left and keeps the batsmen down to a brace.
Pitched on a length, Hasan pushes it off the front foot to mid off.
Length delivery, angling away, punched on the up to covers.
Shortish delivery, angling across, Hasan mistimes his pull back to the bowler.
Iqbal stays in the crease and blocks it.
Full outside off, eased to long off for a single.
Sliding into the batsman, played with the angle to mid-wicket.
Served outside off, pushed to mid off.
Full around off, pushed to covers off the front foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. One run added to the total.
On a length in the line of the stumps, Shakib looks to defend with a straight bat but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length delivery, angling away, dabbed to point.
FOUR! Put away! Short and wide outside off, Al Hasan slaps it past point for a boundary. Gets off the mark in style.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shakib Al Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! Henriques strikes! Fuller length delivery around off tailing in, Rahim presses forward and looks to play it across the line but gets beaten by the ball nipping in. Gets rapped on the back pad and the players go up in appeal. The umpire immediately rules it out. The Aussies are celebrating as it's a big wicket for them. Oh dear, why didn't Rahim go for the review? The replays showed a deflection and the Snicko and Hot Spot confirmed a slight inside edge.
Length delivery around off, angling in, Rahim looks to play it late but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Drinks break! Australia are in a better position as things stand. They've cramped the Bangladesh batsmen for room and scalped a couple of wickets as well. The track is only going to get slower from here. Bangladesh will have to really apply themselves with the bat.
Sliding across Rahim, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.

Full around middle and leg, Rahim kneels down and paddle scoops it past the keeper. Henriques from fine leg, covers good ground to his right and makes a fine, diving stop near the fence. Saves a couple of runs for his team. The umpire goes upstairs to see if it's a clean stop and the replay shows that the Aussie all-rounder did well there.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side.
Head drags his length back, Rahim pulls it on the leg side. Warner at square leg, makes a good stop, diving to his left.
Sliding across Rahim, defended in covers.
Served around leg, flicked to square leg.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Iqbal skips down the track but mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, glided to third man for a single.
Rahim dances down, making room. Henriques smartly bangs it short around off. Rahim looks to flat-bat it but ends up bottom edging it past the leg pole. Reprieve for Rahim!
On a length and angling in, defended on the leg side.
Short delivery, Tamim pulls it with authority but finds Cummins at deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Length delivery outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Moises Henriques is into the attack now.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball. Just 2 from the over.
Iqbal dances down the track, Head looks to spray it wide outside off but ends up bowling a full toss. Tamim goes with hard hands at it but ends up mistiming it to Maxwell at short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full outside off, Tamim prods forward and dabs it behind square on the off side.
Served full around middle, flicked through wide mid on for a single.
Full and sliding in, Iqbal drives it off the front foot on the leg side. Maxwell at short mid-wicket, dives to his right but only half-stops it and concedes a single.
Travis Head replaces Hazlewood!
Angling into Rahim, driven to mid on.
Again it's wide outside off, Iqbal slashes hard at it but gets it off the outer half to third man for a single.
Wide! Length delivery wide outside off, angling away, left alone. A wide is signalled.
Cummins' plan almost works! He follows the bouncer with a full delivery outside off, angling away. Iqbal goes for an expansive drive but gets beaten past his outside edge.
Bumper from Cummins! Iqbal ducks and lets it sail over him. Cummins has so far used this bouncer to a good effect.
On a length around leg, Iqbal tucks it on the leg side from within the crease.
Length delivery, angling away, Iqbal makes a watchful leave.
Full around middle and off, Iqbal prods forward and just plays with soft hands between mid-wicket and mid on for a single.
In the air... but short! Banged in short and angling in, Rahim looks to pull but gets a top edge and the ball falls short of the man at fine leg. A single is taken.
Slightly back of a length, angling away, Iqbal shimmies across and glides it past slip for a run.
Length delivery outside off, Rahim looks to cut but ends up chopping it off the inside half to third man for a single.
Pitched around off, Rahim presses ahead and pushes it in covers.
Slightly ahead of a length around off, nipping in a touch, defended watchfully down the wicket.
Once again it's angling away from the southpaw, Tamim strides forward and leaves it alone. End of a successful over from Cummins!
Bowled at 147 kph, on a length and angling away. Iqbal presses forward and defends it off the inner half on the leg side.
Wide! Banged in short around leg, Iqbal ducks underneath it. The square leg umpire however signals a wide for height.
Pitched outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Banged in short outside off, Rahim leans backwards and leaves it.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the next batsman in. There are two slips in place for him.

OUT! SOFT DISMISSAL! Slightly back of a length and angling away, Kayes punches it on the off side but ends up checking his shot a touch. The ball goes straight at cover-point. Finch there, crouches low and completes a simple catch. Not much celebration around by the Aussies. They know that they have to keep up their good work.
Length delivery around leg, Kayes looks to flick but misses and gets hit on  the thigh pad.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. A maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Length delivery angling across, Iqbal walks across to play at it but fails to get any connection. A decent Powerplay for both teams, they'll be quite content with how it's gone.
Short of a length outside off, comfortably steered to third man for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

On the leg stump line, Iqbal swivels to glance it away with his front leg raised but fails to get any wood on it. It lobs off his thigh pad behind as the keeper runs inside to try and take it, only to just miss. Wouldn't have mattered anyway.
Similar delivery, it's wristed towards mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on off, Tamim gets an inside edge onto his boot as he looks to put bat on ball.
Great effort from the fielder there. Kayes drives it towards mid on and Starc there makes a good stop to save some runs for his side.
Brilliant! Pat Cummins brings out a venomous bouncer. It's going across and is very sharp, the batsman just about manages to evade it.
On the stumps, Iqbal works it towards wide mid on and hares across to complete the run.
On the shorter side of the length, angling down a bit, looks to glance it down fine. Gets it away eventually but off the hips. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Back of a length on middle and leg, a hint of movement away which squares up Kayes just a bit. He defends it off the outer half on the off side, won't get any run for it though.
Better start from Cummins in this over. Drops it on a length as it's angling away, just around off as Sarkar defends it down on the track from within his crease.
Length ball on off, comes half-forward and blocks it back down the track.
Short of a good length, well outside off, easily glided behind point for a single.
A good length ball which is outside off, Kayes has a tame push from inside the line but is beaten past the outside edge.
Fullish in length from Josh, Imrul slogs hard and gets it off the inner half through backward square leg for two.
Good use of the wrists. It's flicked away through backward square leg for a run.
Marginally ahead of a length, moving away on middle and off, Tamim positions himself behind the line and meets it with a straight blade.
Doesn't give Kayes any room to work with, cramps him with a back of a length delivery on off. The batsman can only tap it down a bit square on the off side.
Going across Imrul Kayes, he stands his ground and taps it down in front of point.
Could do better, but this is a start. It's full on middle and off, Iqbal leans across and wrists it to the left of mid on for a brisk single.
Cummins needs to get his radar right. He bowls this on the pads once more, Kayes easily clips it down to fine leg and takes one.
On the pads once more, it's once again tucked behind square on the leg side. Just a single this time.
Bit ahead of a length on leg, Iqbal flicks it off his pads and places it behind square on the leg side. Big gap out there and it'll fetch him two runs.
Pat Cummins is the first change.

IN THE AIR... BUT IT'S SAFE! Hazlewood almost has his second. He bangs it in short on middle and off, Tamim looks to pull but gets a big top edge. It balloons over mid-wicket and falls safely. One run taken. A good over from Hazlewood comes to an end.
On a good length and outside off, played to point for nothing.
Very full and well outside off, Kayes leans into the shot and drives it through extra cover. Mid off runs to his right and cuts it off well with a tumble. Single taken.
Back of a length around off, Kayes stays put and defends it off the back foot.
Imrul Kayes is next in at No.3.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Hazlewood is continuing on with his good run from the last game. Draws first blood for Australia with an excellent delivery. Bowls it just around off, on a length and makes it go away ever so slightly. Soumya Sarkar has a feel for it and ends up getting a nick behind. Matthew Wade dives to his left and takes it comfortably.

Hazlewood with a big appeal for an lbw, but nothing from the umpire. He pitches it on a length and it raps Sarkar on the pads right in front of the stumps. The umpire doesn't respond to the appeal though as the ball landed outside the line of leg stump.
FOUR! This is a good end to the over. Short and wide, width on offer which Iqbal latches on to. Cuts it hard through point to send it across the boundary line.
Square leg drops back.
Full delivery swinging back in, Iqbal leans ahead a touch and flicks it beautifully to square leg. Is unfortunate to find the fielder positioned there.
Good length ball on the fifth stump line, dabbed to point with an angled bat.
Bowling at a good pace, 145 kph, is Starc. Lands it outside off and it's left alone by the batsman. He has been consistently above 140 kph.

FOUR! Super shot! Speared full and tailing back in on middle and off, Tamim Iqbal with a slightly closed face drives it through the left of mid on. Pat Cummins there chases after the ball and even puts in a dive to stop it, but just cannot get to it. Boundary!
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, kept out from within the crease with the full face of the bat.
Fractionally straight in line, it's worked behind square on the leg side for a comfortable two.
Outside off on a length, played to point for no run.
Good single. Follows the previous delivery up well by working it to mid-wicket and crossing over. Sensible stuff.

FOUR! THAT'S HAMMERED! Coming on the back of a superb ton, he's high on confidence right now and it's showing. Iqbal gives the charge, meets the length ball with his meaty bat and crashes it past mid off for a boundary.
Slanting across once more, Sarkar uses the angle and taps it behind point for a single.
Moving across on a good length, quite close to off as Soumya Sarkar plays this with a slightly opened face. Taps it down just beside the stumps as he deals with it comfortably.
Hangs deep inside his crease and blocks it out with the full face of the bat. A maiden over from Starc, good one from him.
Spears a full delivery outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.

Oooh... That could have been close. Banged in short by Starc and it's angling down, Tamim Iqbal looks to pull but ends up getting it off the glove. It lobs behind and much to his relief, falls well short of the slip cordon.
Tailing back in at 141 kph, flicked off the pads by Tamim for no run.
Fired full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Full delivery hurled around off, blocked by staying behind the line in front of covers.
Tight line from Hazlewood to end the over. It's very close to the off stick which cramps Soumya Sarkar for room. He can only defend it right under his nose.
Slanting across on a back of a length, outside off, tapped to point with an angled bat.
Keeps it nice and straight, attacks the stumps and makes Sarkar play at it. It's defended solidly from within the crease.

Another shout, turned down again. Pitched outside leg. Fuller on middle and leg, Iqbal looks to flick but it goes off the pads on the leg side. The batsmen come across but the umpire signals runs. Probably then some bat on that occasion.
Shaping across on a back of a length, Iqbal hangs his bat inside the line as the ball just whizzes past the outside edge.

Loud should for a leg before! But it's turned down, good call by the umpire. Height was the issue. Length delivery taking some extra bounce, Tamim attempts to put bat on ball but is rapped on the pads.
Josh Hazlewood will bowl with the second new ball from the other end. He has two slips in place as well.
A yorker in the opening over itself. At 143 kph, fired just outside off, Sarkar attempts to dig it out on the off side but fails to make connection.
Beaten all ends up! It's on an excellent line, just outside off on a length. It shapes back in and goes past the inside edge of Soumya Sarkar's bat.
On a good length outside off, at 142 kph and invites Iqbal forward. The batsman puts bat on ball and gets a thick edge down to third man for a single.

FOUR LEG BYES! Starc errs in line and plays the price for it. Straying on the pads, Iqbal looks to clip it fine down the leg side but it goes off his pads. Goes away and across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Good carry for Starc once more. Lands it just back of a length and outside off, it's shaping away from Tamim who has nothing to do with it.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery in the channel outside off, Tamim Iqbal covers his line and shoulders his arms to it.

The national anthems are done and dusted and the Australians have taken the field. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar to open for Bangladesh. Mitchell Starc to start the proceedings with the first new ball. He has a couple of slips in place. Here we go...
The players are out for their respective national anthems. Players from both the teams have worn a black armband to protest against terrorist attacks that took place in London.

Pitch Report - Ian Bishop is surprised as to how even Bhuvneshwar Kumar hasn't been able to get any swing here. The wicket is a bit slow with some patches on it and the spinners will come into play as the game progresses. Reckons though that with the overhead conditions, the Australian bowlers, especially Mitchell Starc, should get some movement early on.

Steven Smith says they would have had a bat as well as it's a used wicket. States that the conditions are overcast, so would like to make the most of that. Lets everybody know there's one change, Adam Zampa is in for John Hastings. Adds they have some class players in their line-up and would like to use them. Finishes by saying it's a high pressure situation and pretty much every game is important for them so would like to do their best.

Mashrafe Mortaza says they would like to bat first. Adds this can be a very good wicket to bat on since it's a used pitch and might become slower later on. Mentions they have one change, Mehedi Hasan is in for Mosaddek Hossain. Feels that they were a bowler short last time around but it's not the same this time. States this is a different wicket and they will bat first and put runs on the board.
TOSS - BANGLADESH WIN THE TOSS AND THEY WILL HAVE A BAT FIRST!

The Kangaroos are the favourites to win this game but you can never count out the Tigers as they have a record of creating upsets in a major tournament. The previous two games at The Oval weren't interrupted by rain but today showers have been predicted through the day. The overhead conditions also suggest the same as it's already overcast but let's hope that the rain stays away and we get a full game of cricket.

Hello and welcome to the first Day/Night game of the ICC Champions Trophy, 2017 between Australia and Bangladesh. The former's first match got spoilt by rain and they would be eager to get their first win of this tournament today. The Asian side on the other hand posted a decent total against England but eventually came second.
